Ravi: Quick heads-up: unexpected regen failures on a small percentage of hosted inference pods after yesterday's autoscaler patch. Pausing non-critical rollouts for the train.
Nora: Noted. Canary shows increased 500s on rerank-service from 02:15 UTC. Error trace points to connection resets during scale-up.
Kai: I'm reverting the autoscaler tweak on canary now. Command:
```
kubectl -n canary patch deployment autoscaler --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/args/1","value":"--max-surge=1"}]'
```
ops-bot: [02:25 UTC] Canary rollback initiated. 2/2 pods updated, health checks passing. CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/1201
Nora: After revert, error rate fell to baseline within ~4m. Dev dash: https://dash.redwood.ai/services/rerank (watch region eu-west).
Ravi: Instituting a short release freeze: 02:30-03:30 UTC for all trains touching autoscaler or reroute configs. Exemptions via #eng-releases with test plan.
Kai: Running 30m smoke tests across regions. Will report final pass/fail.
Ravi: Changelog notes queued: autoscaler revert on canary, temporary release freeze 02:30-03:30 UTC, smoke-test plan. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/eng/release-notes/789
Nora: Thx — please post any customer-visible regressions here and @oncall if impacted. :eyes:
